## Security checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private keys, setup codes, database URLs, or private server details are included.
- [ ] User input is validated before use.
- [ ] Command output is redacted before it is stored or returned.
- [ ] No arbitrary shell endpoint was added.
- [ ] App container safety defaults were not weakened.
